messages:
Maria Chen: rolling canary for raven-lite-q4 on canary-1, noticed structured funcall parse failures jumped from baseline ~1.2% -> 6.8% after the quant-only bring-up. quick logs and sample below.

Maria Chen: ```
USER: create_ticket(title="Bug in billing", severity="high")
MODEL OUTPUT (truncated): {
  "tool": "create_ticket",
  "args": {
    "title": "Bug in billing",
    "description": "Customer says charge doubled",
  },
  "metadata": null,
}
```

Jon Patel: trailing comma + extra newline after metadata -> our strict JSON parser fails. Did we change packing/tokenizer or anything else? :thinking_face:

Maria Chen: no tokenizer changes, only quant backend (q4) and batch packing increase to 64 tokens for canary. autoscaler bumped replicas -> 3.

Kevin O'Neal: can repro locally with q4 weights + packing=32 too. model has a bias to emit an extra "," before closing objects in some decoding trajectories.

Jon Patel: can we run a quick A/B against q8h and fp16 to confirm it's quant-specific?

Maria Chen: starting that now, grabbing failing sample ids.

Rae (oncall): created incident inc-2026-234, routed to eng-ml. Alert: funcall_parse_rate > 5% for 10m. :rotating_light:

infra-bot: Canary deploy raven-lite-q4 -> canary-1 started at 4367890123, replicas=3.

Kevin O'Neal: short-term mitigation suggestion: add a tolerant postprocessor that applies lightweight JSON repairs (strip trailing commas, remove stray control chars, allow single quotes) before invoking strict funcall parser. Also bump retry_budget from 2 -> 5 for the canary traffic slice.

Jon Patel: +1 for temporary tolerance but we should not hide failures forever. Long-term: (1) run quant sweep with structured-output calibration (loss + structured-output metrics), (2) add structured-output eval set to onboarding so canary gating covers this.

Maria Chen: action list: 
- Kevin: run q4 vs q8h vs fp16 on the same prompt set and post diffs by EOD
- Jon: open PR for tolerant postprocessor + toggle retry_budget on canary
- Rae: keep paged alerts if rate >=5% and summarize failures for oncall handover

Kevin O'Neal: starting the run now, will tag results here (sample batch id sample_2026_44321).

Maria Chen: copied. I'll also snapshot the failing responses and add them to the structured-output onboarding harness.

Jon Patel: :thumbsup:
